records.name: Häuptling Vollmund
records.biography_en: Vollmund addresses the HyperNorm courtyard with his drinking horn held safely below the proclamation. A card suggesting that confidence can coexist with uncertainty earns another delighted boast: a gathering is either convinced or insufficiently addressed. Hunky & Dory reward his enthusiasm with a larger audience. He privately counts the listeners before deciding how enormous the next victory has been.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Sieg wurde verkündet. Sein Anlass wird unter den Anwesenden vermutet.

variant_notes.note_en: He announces a victory whenever he finds enough listeners to outnumber his doubts.

records.name: Speerführerin Starrsinn
records.biography_en: Starrsinn keeps a HyperNorm doorway under the protection of her small blue shield. A card proposing that changing a position need not mean abandoning it receives her heaviest lower lip: the line is either held or lost. Men in Black appreciate her resolve. She glances sideways at the open space, considering whether a doorway might remain useful without becoming a frontier.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Stellung wird gehalten. Der Durchgang bittet um Berücksichtigung.

variant_notes.note_en: She can hold a position long after the discussion has stopped deserving one.

records.name: Rauner Wurzelrecht
records.biography_en: Wurzelrecht inspects the HyperNorm courtyard foliage beneath a hood that has outlasted several official explanations. A card allowing knowledge to remain incomplete earns his suspicious sideways glance: a remedy is either established or somebody else's enthusiasm. Hunky & Dory request a reassuring conclusion. He turns the tied bundle, giving the leaves another opportunity to complicate the answer.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Auskunft wächst noch. Eine abschließende Wurzel liegt nicht vor.

variant_notes.note_en: He mistrusts explanations that have become simpler than the plant they concern.

records.name: Keulwart Kurzschluss
records.biography_en: Kurzschluss carries a knotted wooden club through the HyperNorm corridor with an objection clenched between his teeth. A card suggesting that restraint can count as strength makes his eyes turn upward: a problem is either settled or still annoying him. Men in Black praise decisive action. He hugs the club closer, briefly keeping the decision on his own side of the discussion.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Entschlossenheit ist anwesend. Der Gegenstand des Einwands verspätet sich.

variant_notes.note_en: He is prepared to settle the matter as soon as he discovers which matter has upset him.

records.name: Fährtenleserin Schrägblick
records.biography_en: Schrägblick studies the HyperNorm entrance from an angle the posted directions do not acknowledge. A card proposing that a detour can reveal the route earns a nearly closed smile: a trail is either verified or inconvenient to its author. Hunky & Dory expect a prompt return. She keeps the arrow close and follows the evidence with the eyebrow that remains raised.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Weg wurde gefunden. Seine Übereinstimmung mit der Vorschrift bleibt offen.

variant_notes.note_en: She considers the official route an interesting clue rather than a binding destination.

records.name: Beutelhüter Nachschlag
records.biography_en: Nachschlag guards the HyperNorm residents' collection in a helmet repurposed as a very small treasury. A card suggesting that shared wealth requires more than shared counting pulls his lip to one side: a coin is either accounted for or in danger of generosity. Men in Black request an orderly total. He starts again, hoping the number will explain who gets to hold it.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der gemeinsame Besitz wird erneut gezählt. Die Hand bleibt dieselbe.

variant_notes.note_en: He counts the common spoils with the care usually reserved for personal exceptions.
